name: The War of Odramir
summary:
The War of Odramir is a 2D medieval fantasy MMORPG featuring top-down pixel art, real-time action combat, and an interconnected multiplayer world. Players can choose from six distinct classes: Warrior, Archer, Mage, Battle Cleric, Assassin, and Druid. Each class offers unique abilities and combat styles.

The game features PvE and PvP combat, challenging monsters and bosses, dungeons, guilds, guild quests and progression, pets, crafting professions, equipment enchanting, and a player-driven economy supported by an auction house. Players can explore diverse environments, gather resources, craft equipment and consumables, participate in Battlegrounds, and develop their characters through equipment progression and character customization.
